title: Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-Makers
abstract: arXiv:2610.25768v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp

translated_title: 预算约束下的截断推理：评估System-1模型作为决策者的表现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通常会生成超出所需的推理标记。限制推理预算可以降低成本，但强制从不完整的推理轨迹中得出答案可能会损害准确性。System-1决策模型可以在不生成推理响应的情况下从候选选项中进行选择。我们评估了Jev作为截断推理的决策读取器，在七个LLM推理模型和五个多选题基准（35组配对）上的表现。在测试的500到16,000个标记的预算范围内，Jev的平均准确率高于强制回答，且该结果已计入推理和回答的估计成本。在1,500个标记的预算下，它整体上提高了4.1个百分点的准确率，在截断问题上提高了8.6个百分点，在Holm校正的bootstrap检验下，有17组配对显示出显著提升。离线重放估计仅花费完整运行成本的34.5%，准确率损失为1.13个百分点。在训练折叠上选择的策略在留出折叠上节省了估计完整运行成本的71.3%，准确率损失仅为0.58个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出用System-1决策模型Jev来读取截断的推理过程并直接做出决策，相比从不完整推理中强制得出答案，在500至16,000标记的各种预算下均能提升准确率，最多可节省约71.3%的推理成本且准确率损失极小。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using a System-1 decision model, Jev, as a decision reader over truncated reasoning traces, showing that it outperforms forced answering across token budgets of 500 to 16,000 while saving up to 71.3% of inference costs with minimal accuracy loss.
